transcript: One morning the alarm rang but I was not eager to get up, I was simply bored. I had been annoyed by the same routine repeating itself every day. I tried to make coffee but the beans had run out. I walked to the neighborhood cafe and ordered coffee from a clerk I knew by sight. I had no cash so I paid by card. On the way back, I met the elderly lady next door Yesterday, I lost my precious ring in the garden, she said An insect bit my hand, and when I waved it, the ring flew off I did not mind helping, I was glad to help After digging for 15 minutes with a shovel, a golden ring appeared From the soil, she laughed and said What good luck you bring young man back at home, a friend called Will you come camping next week, he asked I accepted the invitation, at once I would need to borrow a tent A day I had thought would be boring turned out by the end To be a good day, blessed by circumstance In the ordinary flow of daily life, small events And conversation are always waiting Perhaps every day is after all A little more comfortable than we think
